name: IBM BOB National Hackathon 2026 - Top 5 South Zone (The Sentinel Grid)
stats: Top 5 South Zone · 0.9924 ROC-AUC · 314 automated checks · team of 4
content: Advaith's team of four built The Sentinel Grid and placed in the Top 5 of the South Zone at the IBM BOB National Hackathon 2026 (zonal round, SRCAS Coimbatore). The disaster-intelligence system has 314 automated checks and recomputed all 104 formulas in its specification, catching 2 errors in the spec itself. Its drought detector reached ROC-AUC 0.9924 on 473,256 real district-month soil readings for Coimbatore; monsoon extremes reach only 0.662, which the team reported as the open problem.
